title: Not the Greatest Blanket
text: Not the Greatest Blanket. So, SO rough! The blanket is very rough feeling. It's too large for our home washing machine so I couldn't wash it before use. With a sheet between myself and the blanket the scratchy feeling is somewhat mitigated. Being 100% cotton the blanket breathes well so I find myself sweating less than under a heavy quilted comforter. Not truly happy with this but for now it does the job.

features: SUBTLE SOFTNESS. Woven from the finest 100% Premium Quality Cotton yarns for softness and easy care, this blanket is the perfect layer to add to your bed. Cotton's superior breathability makes these blankets ideal for bedding all year round. Our premium cotton can be machine washed and dried, and will become softer and cozier with each wash

MODERN DESIGN: The simplistic yet stylish design of this blanket features a diamond pattern with self-binding edges; versatile in color and design, this blanket will surely suit any Classic, Modern, Traditional, or Transitional space.

ALL-SEASON COMFORT: This cotton blanket is perfect for all seasons with its breathable and light-weight fabric, so you can enjoy it all year round; featuring a medium weight, these blankets are soft, cozy, and comfortable

DESIGNER FINISH: This throw blanket is elegantly-finished with self-bound edges and mitered corners for a clean look and extra durability making a great gift for housewarmings, engagements, bridal showers, holidays, vacations, dorm rooms, and more

MACHINE WASHABLE: Enjoy easy cleaning with this colorfast cotton blanket. Simply toss it in the washing machine and tumble dry low to return it back to its clean, fresh state; Always follow care label instructions for best results.
description: Embrace the breathable and soft Superior Diamond Cotton All-Season Blanket for a utmost comfort. It features a beautiful diamond weave pattern, and a self-binding hem is constructed into the blanket to provide strength and add a clean crisp edge. Made from 100% Cotton, these beautiful blankets provide lightweight warmth ideal to use all year around. Choose from Aqua, Black, Burgundy, Chocolate, Forest Green, Grey, Ivory, Khaki, Merritt Blue, or White for the perfect bedroom blanket and cotton throw blanket to fit your decor.
